principles.rule: One committed color field or material per surface — mesh header band, gradient type, ink on paper. Not rainbow sections.
Neutrals are tinted (warm or cool gray), not pure #fff/#000. Use 3–5 semantic steps: surface, ink, muted, border, accent.
Hierarchy through value first (ink vs muted), then one accent. Price/display dominates; meta copy stays quiet.
Accent color appears on one job only — primary CTA, tier highlight, or gradient material. Never accent + accent + accent.
Gradients and mesh live in bounded zones (card header, hero band, type fill). Full-bleed decorative gradient = slop unless concept demands it.
Body text ≥ 4.5:1 on surface. Large display can be tighter but must stay readable. Muted meta ≥ 3:1 on white.

notes: Define tokens in :root — avoid raw hex scattered in components
Warm SaaS: surface #fafaf9, muted #78716c. Cool SaaS: surface #f8fafc, muted #64748b
One accent hue max — CTA can be ink-on-white or saturated single hue, not both fighting

pricing.label: Premium pricing / plan card
pricing.palette: White or warm off-white card · warm/cool gray meta · black or brand single-hue CTA · mesh or soft gradient in header band only
do: Large price typography — hierarchy through size/weight
Mesh or gradient confined to card header / tier name zone
Thin line icons or restrained checkmarks — not purple bullet lists
Soft shadow on card + crisp primary button
avoid: Three identical glass cards in a row
Fake 'Most popular' pill on every tier

hero.label: Hero / landing moment
hero.palette: One atmospheric field OR monochrome + one accent · not orb + mesh + glow stack
do: Committed color world tied to product metaphor
Display type carries color if needed
avoid: Purple blob behind centered Inter headline

portfolio.label: Portfolio / editorial
portfolio.palette: Paper + ink · one accent on links or section labels · no gold-on-black template
avoid: Dark zinc + lime accent dev console

auth.label: Auth / OTP
auth.palette: Near-neutral field · atmosphere shifts on focus — hue tied to progress, not static wallpaper
avoid: Static full-page gradient with dead form

default.label: General premium UI
default.palette: Tinted neutrals + one accent + optional one material zone
